item.description:
The menu bar panel now survives a click into another window — it stays put and fades out on its own after a few seconds. Hovering over it holds it open; clicking the icon still closes it instantly.

Settings speaks the modes' language — Clean and Enhanced Clean — with clearer explainers in a more readable face. A new Accounting pack ships in the box, and the Coding pack learns to spell Claude Code.

If you took 0.15.0, this update should install without touching your Accessibility permission — that's the fix from last time doing its job. If the fn key stops working after this update, tell Richard: that's a bug now, not the routine.
